snippet.title: Black Bass with Blue Marlin (1999) PS1 - Gameplay HD
snippet.description:
Black Bass WITH Blue Marlin
REAL-TIME 3-D FISHING!
Black Bass and Blue Marlin together for the first time!
HOT-B delivers dynamic freshwater and saltwater tournament angling action in one game.

FEATURING FISHING LEGEND HANK PARKER
Two-player, split-screen, head-to-head mode
Four enormous, real-life tournament lakes feature 12 marinas, and each bass-packed lake contains thousands of fishes
Twelve exotic marlin fishing tournament locales
Realistic lures, reeling action, environmental factors and fishing spots.

Platform: PlayStation
Genre: Sports » Individual » Nature » Fishing
Developer: Starfish
Publisher: Hot-B
Release: November 18, 1999
Also Known As:
• Super Black Bass X2 & The Blue Marlin (JP)
Franchises: The Black Bass, The Blue Marlin
